Unit of randomisation (individual or cluster): individual

Duration of intervention: 6 months

Follow-up period: 6 months from baseline

Blinding: neither the subjects nor the researcher were blinded to the intervention.

Unit of analysis (individual or cluster): individual

How was the missing data handled? (e.g. available case analysis, imputation methods): available case analysis. Although missing data were reported, all randomised participants were included in the analysis. No imputation method was described.

  • "No limits were placed on the number of patients that could be recruited at each pharmacy and all pharmacists were required to keep an inclusion and non-inclusion register."
